newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: GOLF-MITCHELL SHOOTS COURSE RECORD 63 TO LEAD BY FOUR.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-MITCHELL SHOOTS COURSE RECORD 63 TO LEAD BY FOUR.

text.p: Briton Peter Mitchell carved out a course-record nine-under-par 63 to seize a four-shot lead after the second round of the weather-delayed Madeira Island Open on Saturday.

The 38-year-old Englishman, whose only previous European Tour victory came in the 1992 Austrian Open, will seek a second triumph in Sunday's last round of an event reduced to 54 holes because of bad weather on Thursday.

Mitchell's 36-hole total of 133 put him well clear of second-placed compatriot Andrew Sherborne, who compiled a 65. Five players were tied for third another shot back -- Germans Thomas Goegele and Heinz-Peter Thuel, and Britons Andrew Coltart, Dean Robertson and David Tapping.
Mitchell, who had played four holes with one birdie before darkness forced a halt on Friday, collected two more birdies on his first nine then added four birdies and an eagle by the close.
Currently 14th on the European Ryder Cup list, Mitchell will be 10th if he hangs on to win.
"I'm trying to work on my tempo and play solid golf," he said. "If I can do that and win a couple events, the Ryder Cup will follow but I'm not thinking about that yet."
